image_description: Two male black grouse (blackcocks) in a grassy field. The bird on the left is in mid-action with wings spread and tail fanned, displaying dark plumage. The bird on the right stands alert, showcasing glossy black plumage, prominent red eyebrow combs, and distinctive white undertail coverts.
